# VerticalButton

Vertical button: an icon stacked over a short label, one size (60 by 60). For choosing between a few large options, such as a role.

**Import:** `import { VerticalButton } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/VerticalButton/VerticalButton.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/VerticalButton/VerticalButton.stories.jsx` — Overview, Appearances, States, Selected, Disabled, Loading, HoveredState, PressedState, KeyboardFocus, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/VerticalButton/VerticalButton.mdx`

**Motion:** change `appearance.fast`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Usage

Use `VerticalButton` for a small set of large, equally weighted actions picked at a glance, such as a role or mode at the start of a flow. Its fixed 64 by 64 size suits two to four options.

## Motion

VerticalButton reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Hover and press change color, 90% by about 110 ms. |

## Alternatives

- For actions in a standard horizontal row, use `Button` or `ButtonGroup`.
- For an icon-only action with no visible label, use `IconButton`.
- For a form question with pictured 224px choice tiles, use `RadioGroup` or `CheckboxGroup`.

## Best practices

### Use it to pick among two to four big options. {#use-it-to-pick-among-two-to-four-big-options}

A role at sign-in is the case it is made for. Toolbars and ordinary actions take `Button` or `IconButton`.

Do: Picking a role at sign-in.
Don't: Ordinary actions lined up as a toolbar.

### Use one or two words in sentence case. {#use-one-or-two-words-in-sentence-case}

The label sits under the icon and must fit on one or two lines. The button is a fixed size, so a longer label wraps awkwardly or clips.

Do: A short label under a familiar glyph.
Don't: A long label wraps and breaks the fixed size.

```jsx
<VerticalButton icon="user-gear" label="Admin" onClick={selectRole} />
```

### Pair it with a clear icon. {#pair-it-with-a-clear-icon}

The icon carries the meaning at a glance; the label confirms it.

Do: An icon that matches its label.
Don't: A decorative icon unrelated to the label.

### `icon` is required — there is no text-only variant. {#icon-is-required-there-is-no-text-only-variant}

`VerticalButton` always stacks an icon over the label; a text-only choice
reads better as a plain `Button`.

## Accessibility

- **A real button, unchanged.** `VerticalButton` renders a `Button`
  underneath, so focus, activation and disabled/loading states all follow
  `Button`'s own contract.
- **The label is the accessible name.** The icon is decorative; the visible
  label beneath it is what a screen reader announces.

## Related

- `Button`: use when an action sits in a horizontal row.
- `ButtonGroup`: use when related buttons connect into one row.
- `RadioGroup`: use when asking a form question with pictured choice tiles.

## Parts

1. **Container.** One size, 64 by 64.
2. **Icon.** A Font Awesome Free glyph, stacked above the label.
3. **Label.** One or two words in Body/small at the medium weight.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The container takes the rest fill of its appearance. |
| Hovered | The container takes the hovered fill of its appearance. |
| Pressed | The container takes the pressed fill of its appearance. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the edge, for keyboard focus only. |
| Selected | The selected role fill. Sets `aria-pressed`. |
| Disabled | The disabled fill, label and icon: a change of color, not of opacity. |
| Loading | A spinner replaces the icon and label. Blocks interaction and sets `aria-busy`. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Size | 64 by 64: `--button-vertical-size`. |
| Padding | `--pad-y-sm` and `--pad-x-xs`. |
| Icon-to-label gap | 4: `--inline-sm`. |
| Label | Body/small: `--body-small`, medium weight. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use one or two words in sentence case: "Admin", "Tutor". | A sentence-length label such as "Manage account settings". |
| Name the option, not the action: "Student". | "Click to choose student". |
| Keep sibling labels parallel and about the same length. | One long label among short ones. |
| Pick a glyph that matches the label. | A decorative glyph that says something different. |

| `label` | string (required) | — | One or two words, sentence case. |
| `appearance` | enum | `'default'` | — |
